notes: Each *cannot* is the indivisible fusion of לֹא with יָכֹל under rule 35, headed on the negative as the syntactic head (rule 23).
The italic *it* after *utter* is added: no object morpheme stands in the clause (rule 44).

*nor* fuses the waw with its clause's לֹא, headed on the negative (rule 35); *are full of weariness* is the predicate adjective's own multi-word rendering with the construction-supplied copula, headed on *weariness* (rules 20, 31). Margin 'Or, All words are feeble' read and set aside.
